perks.name: Sweet Benevolence
perks.text: Earn +30% more Candy, Gifts and Chocolate from duplicate rabbits during their respective events.

perks.name: A Time for Giving
perks.text: Spawn Party Chests by killing mobs during the Spooky Festival and collect Party Gifts from Jerry's Workshop.

perks.name: Chivalrous Carnival
perks.text: Schedules a Carnival in the hub, active throughout the entire year.

perks.name: Extra Event
perks.text: Schedules an extra Fishing Festival event during the year.

perk.name: Blooming Business
perk.text: All Garden Visitors reward Fine Flour and +10% Copper for accepting offers. Invites 5 unique visitors to your Garden and makes higher rarity visitors 20% more likely to show up.
